Coram : H.S. BEDI, GYAN SUDHA MISRA
NARCOTIC DRUGS AND PSYCHOTROPIC C SUBSTANCES ACT, 1985: s. 22 read with s. 50 - Right of accused to be informed that he has an option of being searched in the presence of a Gazetted Officer or a Magistrate - Accused found in 0 possession of 2 packets containing 1 kg heroin by him to be searched in presence of a Gazetted Officer - Held: The consent memo cannot be said as informing the accused of his right to be searched in the presence of a Gazetted Officer or a Magistrate, as he was E only given the option to be searched before one of the other - The Officer
Decision Date : 21-07-2011 | Case No : CRIMINAL APPEAL No. 1857/2010 | Bench : 2 Judges
